scope: Offline riverfront rendering, driving, traffic, environment and exploration assets.

assets.source: Project-authored truss, deck and sail geometry informed by public dimensions.
assets.license: Original project geometry; SRFDCL reference imagery is excluded.
assets.geometry: 300 m modeled span, 10–14 m width, instanced tubes and boards plus four procedural fabric sections.
assets.textures: Project palette and local paving materials.
assets.collision: Continuous central deck and rail collision. Bollards exclude cars at the foot entrance.
assets.lod: Instanced elements use engine culling. No authored HLOD.
assets.verification: Atal landing capture; native prior deck and vehicle-block tests.

assets.source: Project-authored two-wing arcade fitted to a riverfront site and a mapped city plot.
assets.license: Original project geometry with CC0 ambientCG surface maps.
assets.geometry: Modular storeys, colonnade, shutter bays, original 78 cm condenser plus shelf brackets.
assets.textures: 1K brick, plaster, normal and roughness maps; original glazing.
assets.collision: Separate solid wings and columns; open alley and perimeter walk.
assets.lod: World mesh instances, no authored building HLOD.
assets.verification: Fixed shopfront view and previous six-leg walking test on each map.

assets.source: ambientCG Asphalt 033, Asphalt 019 and project-authored aggregate and wear blending.
assets.geometry: Applied to existing driveable road surfaces.
assets.textures: 1K color, DirectX tangent normal and roughness maps. Asphalt 033 sampled at 2.5 m.
assets.verification: Normal chase camera and 45 m native drive with road contact.

assets.source: Adapted from tevy’s CC0 Five-Door Hatchback; project right-hand-drive conversion.
assets.license: CC0 1.0 source; original unbadged project adaptation.
assets.geometry: Static body and left/right wheel meshes at four independently animated pivots.
assets.textures: Imported automotive materials with a separate night lens shader on selected slots.
assets.collision: Swept chassis box and ground traces.
assets.lod: Source mesh at close range; no verified authored vehicle LOD chain.
assets.verification: Parked-hatch capture and road drive using the possessed vehicle.

assets.source: Poly Haven Tree Small 02 by Rico Cilliers; project canopy reconstruction.
assets.geometry: 7,708 folded leaves in the prepared mesh; supplementary instanced sprigs.
assets.textures: Source bark and leaf maps; masked foliage.
assets.lod: Reduced source geometry; no measured scene-wide foliage LOD policy.
assets.verification: Visible on the instrumented street and driving route.

assets.source: Original Unreal graph generated by Scripts/build-district-lights.py.
assets.license: Original project work, no third-party source files.
assets.geometry: Instanced inset diffusers and existing vehicle lens slots.
assets.collision: Nonblocking lenses; housings and poles have independent collision.
assets.lod: Lamp lenses are instanced. Direct street lighting is limited to fourteen nearby emitters.
assets.verification: Day/night shader and vehicle lighting checked in native Metal runs.

assets.source: Original per-instance room light and blind shader in Scripts/build-district-lights.py.
assets.license: Original project work, no external textures.
assets.geometry: Assigned to existing glazed openings in modeled building shells.
assets.textures: Texture-free seeded room occupancy, color, curtains and blind bands.
assets.lod: No separate texture residency. Uses the existing glazed instance batch.
assets.verification: Night shopfront capture and material usage check.

assets.source: Split the existing adapted tevy five-door hatch along two front door seams. Preserve UVs and face normals. Scripts/prepare-riverfront-doors.py.
assets.geometry: Independent cabin and two doors with hinge pivots. Four independent wheels and a right-hand-drive cockpit.
assets.collision: Swept chassis and four wheel probes. Door opening checks available clearance.
assets.lod: Three static mesh LODs per hinged part.
assets.verification: Native O/E input, cockpit/bonnet/chase cameras, four contacts, gear change, braking and reverse verified.

assets.source: MakeHuman Community hm08 generic base topology from https://github.com/makehumancommunity/makehuman/blob/master/makehuman/data/3dobjs/base.obj. Source SHA-256 8e761e6624b8f54536409135d1636da63b32486a90d4897f84e121d144f6fb4c. Original garment shaping, colors, rig and animation.
assets.license: CC0 1.0 source. The OBJ carries the 2020 CC0 notice. https://www.makehumancommunity.org/about/license.html
assets.geometry: Two fully clothed fictional meshes, 21,368 and 21,984 triangles, 18 joints and four authored clips each.
assets.textures: GlTF skin, eyes, hair and garment materials with UVs.
assets.collision: Checked routes and crosswalk clearance. Player capsule on the public character.
assets.lod: Animation update budget and distance culling.
assets.verification: Both public skeletal meshes and eight clips saved by the Unreal commandlet. One pedestrian crossed under signal control during input QA.

assets.source: Original unbadged parametric coachwork in Scripts/make-district-fleet.py.
assets.license: Original project models, running wheels use the credited CC0 hatch wheel.
assets.geometry: Twelve silhouettes with attached rotating two-, three- or four-wheel assemblies.
assets.textures: Shared PBR palette, glazing and independent amber emergency beacons.
assets.collision: Swept near-player bodies and lane spacing at distance.
assets.verification: 23 traffic agents on six directed riverfront circuits. Measured forward travel, stops and turning.

assets.source: Poly Haven Kloofendal 48d Partly Cloudy Pure Sky and Industrial Sunset 02 Pure Sky; licensed photographs converted with Scripts/prepare-riverfront-skies.py.
assets.geometry: Camera-centred dome, directional lighting independent of the panorama.
assets.textures: Two 2K sky panoramas, tonemapped, azimuth-aligned and cooked locally.
assets.verification: Golden and night captures on Metal SM5.

assets.source: Project-authored glass, lathed brass, ceramic, timber, canvas and paint. Original Gujarati and English shop signs.
assets.license: Original work. Font software and satellite imagery are excluded.
assets.geometry: Separate enterable rooms, signage, shelves, merchandise, counter and clear door apertures.
assets.textures: Two signage textures; parameterized PBR surfaces.
assets.collision: Swept player capsule to the tea counter.
assets.verification: Actual windowed shopfront, counter and walking evidence.

assets.license: Original project audio, no recordings of people.
assets.textures: PCM source waves and Unreal audio packages.
assets.collision: Proximity, location, RPM and road contact drive playback.
assets.lod: Ranged playback and ambience volume fades.
assets.verification: Unreal import succeeded. Weather and horn inputs exercised. Subjective audio mix needs listening review.

assets.source: Rain response layered on the existing credited ambientCG Asphalt 033 photogrammetry.
assets.license: CC0 1.0 scanned surfaces and original shader.
assets.geometry: World-space puddle distribution and roughness variation.
assets.textures: Albedo, normal and roughness at captured scale.
assets.collision: Dry and wet traction differ at the four wheel probes.
assets.verification: Monsoon input, wetness transition and drive on rain-soaked road verified.
